name: Burrowing Tortoise
notes: Heavy delta tortoise that digs deep tunnels. The Taj Nagaraptors (faction_taj_nagaraptors) use the burrows as nest foundations; the tortoise gains predator warning in return.
journal_prompt: A large, long-lived tortoise (living 80-120 years) that digs spiral tunnels in a symbiotic relationship with the Nagaraptors, forming the underground foundations of the Taj Nest-Homes.
